qualification: Shared PaneFilterMatcher implements bounded linear-time literal KMP over escaped display text with ASCII-only folding, no locale/path interpretation or regex. Pattern<=4096 bytes checked before copy; prefix storage bounded by pattern size. Stop checks every<=256 display bytes and completion. Hidden=true only is excluded when hidden rows disabled; unknown/denied remain visible. Existing in-memory pane projection now shares these exact semantics.

Disk lookup reserves/initializes128*N bytes for all original rows. Included ranks fill the front and excluded ranks the tail, with roles1/2 and4/3 respectively. Every original ID keeps a checked opposite-half pair, full permutation proof and source address. Query validates included/excluded rank boundary plus schema, generation, role, CRC and both matching halves; no excluded-ID RAM set.

Lookup rows() is visible count and total_rows() original count. locate_row returns Available(nullopt) for valid exclusions, distinct from errors/foreign keys. Scalar find_row reports NotApplicable for exclusions without revocation. Filtered pages use bounded random visible entry/record reads, independent row/wire caps and no directory scan; complete views retain sequential fast path. Filtered continuation cursors are rejected by the source store. End checks source native size, including all-excluded views.

Full PaneView binds order, hidden flag, substring and case sensitivity in preparation/pending/publication gates. Filter-only changes reuse complete ordered source records and build an independently owned lookup. Wrong-filter replies reject. Page budgets charge copied filter text. Focus retains excluded original key with no visible position; hidden explicit targets reject, clearing filter restores its position. New navigation initializes first visible key or none.

Existing unfiltered lookup/pane tests remain regression coverage.

Native/core view filtering only: no Files application, UI scheduling/view graph, rendered-window or full-app latency/RSS qualification. UI must bound retained pages/queues and use serialized workers/owner-free display payloads.

Filtering literal escaped display text is independent of native lookup, filesystem case sensitivity/normalization and destination collision/preservation rules. It must not be reused as operation authority or path parsing.

All original source records and128*N lookup bytes remain even when no rows match. This preserves ID/reverse-pair proof and future hidden-selection handling; it does not claim physical allocation/RSS or cumulative IO bounds. Native calls may block; cancellation is cooperative.

A retained hidden focus key has no visible position/selected displayed row. Future source acquisition must enforce visible/hidden-selection review and fresh native identity/capability validation; cached keys never authorize operations or waive scoped metadata-loss consent.
